note: Engine cases for the CLEANROOM Charities (Jersey) Law 2014 charity-test
projection (projections/charity-test.dmn). 25 worlds x 40 decisions = 1000
pins.
ACTIVATION CONTRACT. Every value below is EVALUATED BY THE L4 BINARY over
charity-test.l4, never hand-typed and never read back off a DMN engine -- a
pin regenerated from the thing it pins is vacuous. Regenerate with
projections/make-cases.py, which appends one #EVAL per (world, decision) to a
copy of the corpus, runs `l4 --json`, and re-keys the printed records using
the FEEL component names read out of the emitted DMN's own itemDefinitions.
The only hand-authored content is WHICH (entity, purpose) pair each case
probes, and the one-line reason in its name.
WHY A CASE IS A PAIR. The exporter merges the `entity` GIVEN of 17 decisions
and the `purpose` GIVEN of 21 into two global inputData (D-PARAM-AS-INPUT), so
a DMN world fixes one entity AND one purpose. The pairs are chosen so the
global purpose is one the entity actually holds, except where the point is a
mixed purpose list.
STATUS 2026-08-02 -- THE SHIPPED ARTIFACT DOES NOT EXECUTE, on either engine.
Two decisions carry L4 list quantifiers (`any` / `all` over `entity's
purposes`) that the exporter has no FEEL form for; both are Blocking in
charity-test.fidelity.txt, both are emitted as raw L4, and both engines refuse
the whole file at compile/parse. Verbatim banners, and the cause-isolation
probe that shows they are the ONLY blocker, are in ../PROJECTIONS.md and
evidence/. This file is therefore a pinned expectation waiting on an exporter
fix, not a passing gate -- and it is committed in that state deliberately, so
the fix has something to be measured against.
THE SEVEN PINS THE PROBE DISAGREES WITH ARE THE FINDING, not noise. With the
two bodies hand-patched to FEEL `some`/`every`, both engines build and answer
1000/1000 SUCCEEDED but only 993/1000 as expected. The seven live in the three
worlds whose entity holds MORE THAN ONE purpose. In the other 22 the global
purpose coincides with the sole list element, which masks the defect entirely.
See ../PROJECTIONS.md sec. 4.
